meta.name: Wikipedia Data-Visualization Cartography
meta.description: A cartography of ~2,000 Wikipedia pages around data visualization — the flagship sigma.js demo graph. Pages are the sole vertex kind, discriminated by their `tag` (Tool, Person, Field, Chart type, Concept, Method, Company, Organization, Technology, List, unknown) and connected by directed `links_to` hyperlinks. Each page carries its ForceAtlas2 position (x/y), a PageRank-like `score`, and its community-detected topic `cluster`; the cluster colour/label registry and the tag icon-asset registry ride on `meta`.
